title: I'm not famous... but my brother is
intro_text: I'm not famous... but my brother is.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Doug is a businessman, and a photographer. He is also the founder of Care to Learn, an organization that helps poor children in the US do well in school. He's married with three children, and he and his family have a normal life. But for many people, he is always blank's brother.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Doug's life can be difficult. People follow him on the street. They ask him questions about his brother, his brother's ex-wife, who is also very famous, and their six children. The paparazzi follow Doug's children and take photographs.

segments.speaker: doug
segments.text: I go to movie premieres and I meet famous actors. And when I call people and ask for money for Care to Learn, it helps when I say I'm blank's brother.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Doug is not jealous of his older brother. He is happy with his life.

segments.speaker: doug
segments.text: I see the world of famous people from the outside. I can leave it, but my brother can't.
